newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish bond yields, crown stable despite high PPI.
newsitem.headline: Swedish bond yields, crown stable despite high PPI.

text.p: Swedish debt yields and the crown were nearly unchanged in the early session despite higher-than-expected May PPI data.

"The higher producer prices are mostly due to one-time factors. Prices on meat increased by 0.4 pct due to a slaughter of beef in The Netherlands. Because of this, the market reacted calmly," one dealer said.
Swedish producer prices rose by 0.7 percent in May against the expected 0.3 percent.

Six months T-bill rates inched down one basis point to 4.12 percent. The ten-year bond yields were unchanged at 6.66 percent. The crown was stable at 4.4550 against the mark compared to 4.4580 late on Wednesday.
